pay_rationale: Agricultural labourers earn significantly below the average casual labour wage due to widespread underemployment and informal wage structures in rural areas.

title: Construction Managers
ai_exposure_rationale: AI will assist with project management, scheduling, and cost estimation software, but the core work of physical site coordination, team management, and stakeholder negotiation remains heavily human-centric.
growth_outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, infrastructure development, and real estate expansion in India drive strong demand for construction management professionals.
pay_rationale: Construction managers require specialized technical and administrative skills, commanding wages significantly above the average regular salaried worker.

title: Chemists
ai_exposure_rationale: AI and machine learning significantly accelerate chemical formulation, data analysis, and literature reviews, but physical laboratory experimentation, synthesis, and quality control still require human presence.
growth_outlook_rationale: Demand for chemists is driven by the expansion of India's pharmaceutical, chemical manufacturing, and quality assurance sectors.
pay_rationale: As professional scientific workers, qualified chemists earn above the average for regular wage-salaried employees in India.

title: Landscape Architects
ai_exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist with drafting, 3D modeling, and conceptual layout design, but landscape architecture still requires physical site analysis and creative human judgment.
growth_outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, infrastructure development, and increasing focus on green spaces and sustainable urban design in India are driving demand.
pay_rationale: Professional landscape architects earn above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to specialized design skills.

title: Financial and Investment Advisors
ai_exposure_rationale: AI tools can efficiently generate portfolio recommendations and financial models, but human trust, personalized advice, and regulatory compliance remain essential.
growth_outlook_rationale: Growing formalization of household savings and rising disposable incomes in India are driving strong demand for professional financial advisory services.
pay_rationale: Specialized knowledge and management of significant capital allow financial advisors to earn well above the standard salaried worker average.

title: Computer Network Professionals
ai_exposure_rationale: AI tools can automate routine network monitoring, configuration, and basic troubleshooting, but hands-on hardware implementation and architectural judgment still require human professionals.
growth_outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by the rapid expansion of cloud computing, 5G rollouts, and enterprise digitization across India.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills place these professionals significantly above the national average for salaried employees.

title: Medical Imaging and Therapeutic Equipment Technicians
ai_exposure_rationale: AI assists in image analysis and quality control, but the physical operation of equipment and direct patient management remain hands-on.
growth_outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of healthcare infrastructure, diagnostic centers, and hospitals in India is driving strong demand for technical healthcare roles.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical training allows these professionals to earn moderately above the average for regular wage/salaried employees.

title: Securities and Finance Dealers and Brokers
ai_exposure_rationale: Much of transaction execution and market data analysis is increasingly automated through algorithmic trading platforms and robo-advisors, though client-facing advisory and negotiation roles still require human judgment.
growth_outlook_rationale: Driven by India's expanding retail investor base, rising capital market participation, and growing financialization of household savings, demand for financial brokers and dealers is expected to grow strongly.
pay_rationale: As regular wage or salaried professionals in the financial sector, their specialized knowledge and performance-linked incentives place their earnings above the average salaried worker.

title: Scribes and Related Clerks
ai_exposure_rationale: AI and smartphone proliferation (voice-to-text, automated form-filling, digital government services) directly automate the core tasks of scribes who help illiterate individuals with paperwork.
growth_outlook_rationale: As digital literacy and mobile internet penetration expand across India, the demand for traditional human scribes helping with letters and forms is steadily declining.
pay_rationale: Scribes typically earn low, informal incomes well below the average for regular wage or self-employed workers.

title: Fashion and Other Models
ai_exposure_rationale: While digital avatars and AI-generated imagery pose a growing challenge for traditional modeling in advertising and e-commerce, live fashion shows, fit modeling, and high-end artistic creation still require human presence.
growth_outlook_rationale: Driven by the expansion of the Indian retail sector, e-commerce platforms, digital marketing, and the fashion industry, demand for visual advertising talent is expected to grow steadily.
pay_rationale: Successful models can earn significantly above the average service worker salary, though earnings vary widely based on individual prominence and commercial contracts.

title: Inland and Coastal Waters Fishery Workers
ai_exposure_rationale: Fishery work is overwhelmingly physical and outdoor, requiring manual labor and traditional knowledge of water bodies with minimal digital touchpoints.
growth_outlook_rationale: Employment in traditional inland and coastal fishing faces stagnation and pressure from overfishing, environmental degradation, and shifting commercial practices.
pay_rationale: Inland and coastal fishing in India is largely informal and subsistence-driven, resulting in earnings generally below the average for self-employed or casual workers.

title: Glaziers
ai_exposure_rationale: Glazing is a physical, manual trade involving measuring, cutting, and installing heavy materials on construction sites, which AI cannot automate.
growth_outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by robust urban real estate development, infrastructure projects, and increasing use of architectural glass.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as casual labour or low-end regular wage workers in the construction sector, earning slightly below or near category averages.

title: Agricultural and Industrial Machinery Mechanics and Repairers Divison
ai_exposure_rationale: The work is fundamentally hands-on, requiring physical diagnosis and mechanical repair of heavy equipment, meaning AI can only assist with documentation or digital manuals.
growth_outlook_rationale: Demand is steadily growing due to increased farm mechanization and industrialization across India, though it remains a specialized trade.
pay_rationale: Skilled mechanical technicians earn somewhat above the average wage for regular or self-employed workers due to specialized technical knowledge.

title: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Mechanics and Fitters and Related Workers, Not Elsewhere Classified
ai_exposure_rationale: The work involves physical mechanics, equipment inspection, battery repair, and manual winding, leaving little room for direct AI automation.
growth_outlook_rationale: Demand grows steadily with expanding electrification, consumer electronics, and automotive sectors in India, though much of the work remains informal.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as regular wage or self-employed craft workers earning slightly below broader formal salaried averages.

title: Shoemakers and Related Workers
ai_exposure_rationale: Shoemaking and leather repair are predominantly manual, craft-based trades requiring physical dexterity and material manipulation, leaving them largely insulated from direct AI automation.
growth_outlook_rationale: Traditional artisan shoemakers and repairers face ongoing pressure from mass-produced, inexpensive footwear and modern retail manufacturing, resulting in stagnant or slightly declining demand for traditional craft labor.
pay_rationale: Most shoemakers and leather workers operate in the informal sector as self-employed artisans or small workshop workers earning below the broader self-employed average.

title: Fibre Preparing, Spinning and Winding Machine Operators
ai_exposure_rationale: Machine operators require physical presence and manual intervention to tend textile machinery, limiting AI's direct impact mainly to automated monitoring systems.
growth_outlook_rationale: The Indian textile industry is expanding due to government support and exports, though increasing mechanization moderates direct job growth.
pay_rationale: As semi-skilled operatives in manufacturing, earnings typically fall below the national average for regular wage or salaried workers.

title: Assemblers, Not Elsewhere Classified
ai_exposure_rationale: While the physical assembly work cannot be directly automated by AI, industrial automation and robotics will increasingly handle routine assembly processes.
growth_outlook_rationale: Growth will be supported by the expansion of manufacturing under 'Make in India', though partially offset by automation.
pay_rationale: Typically low-skilled or semi-skilled manual labor positions earning near or slightly below the category average.
